comment_regular: Verified .cmp mode-mask bit meanings from Oblivion consumers: 0x1 enables the tree channel (DistantLOD_UpdateExteriorGrid pairs this with bDisplayLODTrees); 0x2 enables the building/object channel (paired with bDisplayLODBuildings and CellsWithLODObjects); 0x4 enables the LandLOD channel (DistantLOD_UpdateLandLODMap). Default mask 0x7 enables all three.
